inspiration: Ruins as discovery events: a short list of rewards (culture, a free worker, a free settler), each with a notification line, and some rewards are excluded on harder difficulties (Ruins.json; excludedDifficulties at line 12). The rule that picks a reward was not read. Fit for zone discovery and loot: one reward per ruin, and harder difficulties remove the easy ones (row 18, zones).

Difficulty as a data row: one table of scalars per difficulty for barbarian bonus, barbarian spawn delay, unit cost, research cost, and happiness base (Difficulties.json; barbarianSpawnDelay at line 14). Fit for spawn tuning as zone data: a delay before a new wave, and a per-difficulty bonus, both as numbers (row 23).

Era-keyed ambience: one looping city bed per era, from ancient to future, plus variants for information and atomic eras (android/assets/sounds/cityAncient.ogg through cityFuture.ogg). Fit for ambience beds per biome and crossfades at borders (sound-music topic).

Tile variant rules with a fallback: a rule-variant table maps composite terrain names (e.g. a grassland cell with a river) to an ordered list of tiles, with a fallback tileset and a flag to use the colour as the base terrain (TileSets/FantasyHex.json line 2 and line 6). Fit for zone art variants and a colour fallback for the minimap (hud-ui).

Unit roster as a 100-row data table: each unit has a type, movement, strength and ranged strength, cost, a required tech and an obsolete tech, plus text uniques (Units.json; rangedStrength at line 96). Fit for catalogue fields (row 21): role, reach, cost, unlock and retirement as separate fields.

Policy list as data (Policies.json, about 70 entries; only the count was checked, the structure was not read). If the entries form a tree, that is a shape to check before reuse. Fit for progression (build diversity) once read.

briefs.label: Ruin discovery chest
briefs.why: A single found ruin that rolls one reward from a short list makes exploration pay without a shop screen. Readable as a 375 px pop-up with one line of text.
briefs.keep: A short reward list per ruin; a one-line notification; a difficulty gate that removes the easy rewards. (The selection rule was not read.)
briefs.change: Rewards are loot rolls tied to the zone (no free units); the reveal is a chest lid and a rarity sound, not a text line. Keep Dom's rule: our own reward list and our own ceremony.

briefs.label: Era-bed biome ambience
briefs.why: A bed per era gives instant place and time without any on-screen label, and a crossfade makes a border feel like a border.
briefs.keep: One looping bed per context; crossfade when the context changes.
briefs.change: Beds are per biome and per zone tag, with a short stinger on crossing a border instead of a long crossfade. Keep Dom's rule: our own music and sound, never these files.
briefs.ref: android/assets/sounds/cityAncient.ogg through cityFuture.ogg (paths only; not played)

briefs.label: Terrain variant with colour fallback
briefs.why: A composite terrain (base plus feature) that falls back to a colour keeps the minimap readable when art is missing.
briefs.keep: Ordered tile variants per composite terrain; a colour fallback flag.
briefs.change: Variants keyed by our zone tag and our palette ramp (row 16); the minimap colour is our own. Keep Dom's rule: our own tile set.
